title: Add Element/ShadowRoot isParsing and signal parse end
body:
Add `isParsing` on `Element` and `ShadowRoot` (`true` while on an HTML/XML parser's stack of open elements, while a declarative `<template shadowrootmode>` or `<template for>` patch targeting the node is on the stack of open elements, or while an HTML fragment parser's root redirection targets the node), defer finishing intermediate open elements in the adoption agency algorithm until `furthestBlock` is detached, and invoke DOM's "signal parse end" when parsing finishes.

Depends on #13308 and #13309.
Companion DOM PR: https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1532
Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65489.
Fixes #13198.
Fixes #12200.
